meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等常驻内核引擎分析你的 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据:先探测文件大小与可用内存,再决定把计算放在内存、原地流式还是远程执行;必要时出图,重任务会报告行数与耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据集,或做分组、聚合、时间序列等操作、清洗数据、绘制图表时触发。

say.text: 分析一下 data.csv,按城市分组统计订单量
say.note: 用 DuckDB 原地查询,并报告行数与耗时

say.text: 把 sales.parquet 清洗后导出成 CSV
say.note: 先探测文件大小和内存再决定在哪算

say.text: 画出这份数据的分布图
say.note: 按可视化规范选图并做视觉检查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude analyzes your CSV, Parquet or JSON data with resident-kernel engines such as DuckDB and Polars: it probes file size and free RAM, then places computation in memory, streaming or remote, and reports row counts and timing for heavy work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze a CSV, Parquet or JSON dataset, or to do grouping, aggregation, time-series work, cleaning or plotting.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv and count orders grouped by city
say_en.note: Runs a DuckDB query in place and reports rows and timing

say_en.text: Clean sales.parquet and export it as CSV
say_en.note: Probes file size and RAM before choosing where to compute

say_en.text: Plot the distribution of this dataset
say_en.note: Picks a chart type and runs the visual check
